entities.page_title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for U.S. Visa Holders from Pakistan
entities.title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for U.S. Visa Holders from Pakistan
entities.summary: The United States Mission in Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for Pakistani citizens renewing B1/B2 tourist and business visas. Eligible applicants can submit their applications through an interview waiver process.
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with valid or expired B1/B2 visas within the last 48 months
application_process: Submit application through interview waiver process
important_notes: Some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear for an interview
Applicants can cancel their interview appointment and submit through interview waiver process if eligible
